Notices written by this MCP server (continuity of care, coverage and population notices) are not source statements: never introduce one with "the label states" or "LactMed says".

structuredContent.answer_rules: Look up FDA notices about a medicine. Choose one kind: recalls: drug enforcement recall candidates, including historical records (drug required; manufacturer and lot optional). Show each candidate with manufacturer, product text, lots, dates, exact status, reason and official link, including when the supplied lot does not match. A literal lot mention is NOT confirmation; ranges and all-lot notices need verification. Never clear a bottle from absent or different lot results. Consumer instructions may be missing: refer to the official notice or a pharmacist. safety_communications: titles, dates and links on the current FDA Drug Safety Communications index (drug optional). Not full notices or all archives. shortages: FDA drug-shortage records (drug required; dosage_form and status optional). Preserve presentation, availability and update dates: a Current shortage can include an Available presentation. No local pharmacy-stock, substitution or dosing inference. reporting_links: official FDA MedWatch and NIH/FDA public-involvement links (no drug needed). No report is submitted; reporting does not prove causation or replace urgent care. For every kind, no match does not establish safety. Never invent notices or instructions, and do not collect identifiable medical details.
